title: Automations with a fixed time don't always start reliably
body: **Translated by Google.** Since creating the automations, I've been using a Pixel 4a and now a 6a, with different Android versions (now 16). The AAPS versions have also been different. Currently running _3.3.3.a + ai3.1.0_. Before that, I was using _3.2.x + ai3.0.1._ There are two blocks for the automations that are queried. _**First block are the tiles/buttons that you can create yourself:**_ ``` 20:26:42.671 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTimeRange.shouldRun():45]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 08:00 und 22:00 20:26:42.671 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerConnector.shouldRun():73]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 08:00 und 22:00 20:26:42.672 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTimeRange.shouldRun():45]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 08:00 und 23:00 20:26:42.677 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerConnector.shouldRun():73]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 08:00 und 23:00 20:26:42.678 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTimeRange.shouldRun():45]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 08:00 und 23:00 20:26:42.679 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerConnector.shouldRun():73]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 08:00 und 23:00 20:26:42.679 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTimeRange.shouldRun():45]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 07:00 und 21:00 20:26:42.684 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerConnector.shouldRun():73]: Ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 07:00 und 21:00 20:26:42.685 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-87] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTimeRange.shouldRun():48]: NOT ready for execution: Für die Zeit zwischen 06:00 und 13:00 ``` _**The second block are the automations that are queried in the background and are intended to set/reset TTs or values. (This is the block that doesn't always work reliably):**_ ``` 20:26:43.997 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [AutomationPlugin.processActions$automation_fullRelease():272]: processActions 20:26:44.001 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerRecurringTime.shouldRun():45]: NOT ready for execution: Jeder/jede/jedes Mo,Di,Mi,Do,Fr,Sa,So 20:00 20:26:44.006 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerRecurringTime.shouldRun():45]: NOT ready for execution: Jeder/jede/jedes Mo,Di,Mi,Do,Fr,Sa,So 23:00 20:26:44.008 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerRecurringTime.shouldRun():45]: NOT ready for execution: Jeder/jede/jedes Mo,Di,Mi,Do,Fr 06:50 20:26:44.010 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerWifiSsid.shouldRun():53]: Ready for execution: WiFi SSID ist gleich OrdnungsBox 20:26:44.011 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerLocation.shouldRun():98]: NOT ready for execution: Beim Betreten des angegebenen Gebiets Schule 20:26:44.012 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerLocation.shouldRun():98]: NOT ready for execution: Beim Verlassen des angegebenen Gebiets Schule 20:26:44.015 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTempTarget.shouldRun():34]: Ready for execution: Temporäres Ziel nicht vorhanden 20:26:44.016 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerBgAcceWeight.shouldRun():53]: set bgAccel_ISF_weight NOT ready for execution: acce weight ist gleich oder größer als 0.2 20:26:44.019 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTempTarget.shouldRun():34]: Ready for execution: Temporäres Ziel nicht vorhanden 20:26:44.021 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerBgAcceWeight.shouldRun():53]: set bgAccel_ISF_weight NOT ready for execution: acce weight ist gleich 0.0 20:26:44.024 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTempTarget.shouldRun():34]: Ready for execution: Temporäres Ziel nicht vorhanden 20:26:44.025 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerIobTH.shouldRun():53]: set iob_threshold_percent NOT ready for execution: iobTH percent ist größer als 75 20:26:44.026 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerIobTH.shouldRun():53]: set iob_threshold_percent NOT ready for execution: iobTH percent ist gleich oder kleiner als 65 20:26:44.030 [RxCachedThreadScheduler-78] D/AUTOMATION: [TriggerTempTarget.shouldRun():34]: Ready for execution: Temporäres Ziel nicht vorhanden ``` _**The second block always starts with this:**_ `D/AUTOMATION: [AutomationPlugin.processActions$automation_fullRelease():272]: processActions` I think I now understand why automations from the second block don't launch on some days. These are automations with a fixed time. Both blocks are queried at very different intervals. The interval can be from a few seconds to several minutes. Why so different, is the question? For tiles (first block), it doesn't matter if they appear a little later. However, for the second block, there are sometimes fixed times when the automation should launch. If this falls within a range with a longer query interval, the automation won't launch. What determines the query interval? _**Example query for the second block:**_ At 8:26:18 PM and at 8:26:20 PM (even twice), after 3 seconds and then again after 10 seconds. 5 queries within 25 seconds. No queries from 8:00 PM to 8:05:22 PM (an automation should start at 8:00 PM). [There was no query at 8:00 PM, which was the first time in the log.] From 8:09:07 PM to 8:20:39 PM, there was no query for 11 minutes (!). The 8:00 PM query exceeded a tolerance, and the start was discarded. I have automations with three fixed times. About once a week, one of them is discarded. That doesn't make much sense to me. Why not a fixed interval of a few minutes with a certain tolerance? This would prevent start times from being overlooked. [AndroidAPS Log.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/22717227/AndroidAPS.Log.zip)

comments.body:
There a a few conditions to run automation on background:
* Loop must be enabled and be in OPEN, CLOSE, LGS mode
* Pump must be in connected state
* Objective 10 must be started

and only latest dev is supported here

All three requirements are met.
The problem has existed since automations with a fixed time were used.
Regardless of which AAPS or Android version was used.

I'll wait for the next final version.
If it happens again, I'll write again.

The error also occurs in final version 3.4.0.0 + ai3.2.0. 
All three requirements/conditions are met.
